'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Mumbai boat accident]]
**At least fifteen people are killed after an [[Indian Navy]] craft collides with a passenger [[ferry]] off the coast of [[Mumbai]], India. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/mumbai/mumbai-boat-accident-body-of-missing-boy-found-off-mumbai-coast-toll-rises-to-15/article69012138.ece (The Hindu)]
*A [[Bombardier Challenger 300]] aircraft flying from [[Punta del Este]], [[Uruguay]], veers off the runway while trying to [[landing|land]] at [[San Fernando International Airport]] in the [[Province of Buenos Aires]], [[Argentina]], and collides with a house, killing the two pilots onboard. [https://buenosairesherald.com/society/private-jet-crashes-in-buenos-aires-residential-area-killing-two (''Buenos Aires Herald'')] 
*[[Ibadan Christmas funfair crowd crush]]
**Thirty-five children are killed and six others are injured in a [[Crowd collapses and crushes|crowd crush]] during a [[Christmas]] [[Fair|funfair]] in [[Ibadan]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c89xdd07585o (BBC News)] 
*Twenty-five people are killed and dozens of others are missing when a boat capsizes on a river in [[Inongo]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/18/search-continues-for-missing-after-drc-boat-capsizing-kills-dozens (Al Jazeera)]
*Twenty people are killed and five others are [[Rescue|rescued]] in a [[shipwreck]] carrying migrants [[Shipwrecking|sinking]] off the coast of [[Sfax]], [[Tunisia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tunisia-migration-shipwreck-sfax-mediterranean-border-europe-a9ba74391a7e14b98b11f7767fe5dcff (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Russia]]n state media agency [[TASS]] claims that the nation developed an [[mRNA vaccine|mRNA]] [[cancer vaccine]], which is planned to be distributed to patients free of charge beginning next year. '''International relations'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[Chinese espionage in the United States]]
***Two [[Chinese-Americans|Americans of Chinese descent]] plead guilty to running a covert [[secret police]] surveillance station on behalf of the [[Ministry of Public Security (China)|Chinese Ministry of Public Security]] to monitor, threaten and coerce [[Chinese people|ethnic Chinese]] in [[Chinatown, Manhattan]], [[New York City]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States. At least 100 such stations have been reported worldwide across 53 countries, with [[human rights]] monitoring [[Non-governmental organization|NGOs]] accusing China of using the outposts to threaten and monitor Chinese nationals abroad. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c785n9pexjpo (BBC)]
*[[Indonesia–Philippines relations]]
**[[Mary Jane Veloso]], a former inmate on [[death row]] in [[Indonesia]], is [[Repatriation|repatriated]] to the [[Philippines]] following negotiations between the two countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/filipina-death-row-prisoner-indonesia-arrives-home-philippines-2024-12-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Malaysia–United States relations]]
**The [[U.S. Department of Defense]] repatriates two [[al-Qaeda]] members, [[Mohammed Farik Bin Amin]] and [[Mohammed Nazir Bin Lep]], from [[Guantanamo Bay detention camp|Guantanamo Bay]] to [[Malaysia]], where they will undergo a [[Rehabilitation (penology)|rehabilitation process]] before [[Prisoner reentry|reintegration into society]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/two-guantanamo-bay-detainees-back-malaysia-will-undergo-rehabilitation-bernama-2024-12-19/ (Reuters)]
